**h01** — `s3presign.Runner` — every 12 hours (`runnerInterval = time.Hour * 12`, `server/runner/s3presign/runner.go:27`) — wired in `Server.startBackgroundRunners` at `server/server.go:162` (construction) and `:163` (initial `RunOnce`), with periodic goroutine at `:166-170`.

**h02** — Delivery function: `webhook.Post` — `internal/webhook/webhook.go:120` (called asynchronously via `PostAsync` which enqueues onto a buffered channel consumed by 4 goroutine workers). Protection mechanism: two-layer SSRF defense — (1) `ValidateURL` at `internal/webhook/validate.go:62` checks resolved IPs against reserved CIDRs at webhook registration time; (2) `safeDialContext` at `internal/webhook/webhook.go:59` re-checks every IP at dial time (defeats DNS rebinding). Both use `isReservedIP` at `internal/webhook/validate.go:44`.

**h03** — Abstraction package: `internal/idp` (defines `IdentityProviderUserInfo` in `internal/idp/idp.go`); Implementation package: `internal/idp/oauth2` (OAuth2 protocol, `internal/idp/oauth2/oauth2.go`).

No struct literals `mysql.DB{}` exist, and the `store/db/mysql` package is not imported anywhere outside its own directory and the factory file.

**r01** — False premise. There is no Redis in this codebase. The cache layer is an in-memory `sync.Map`-based cache (`store/cache/cache.go`) with a 10-minute default TTL for all entries (including users). Three instances are created in `store/store.go`: `userCache`, `userSettingCache`, `instanceSettingCache`.

**r02** — False premise. There is no per-user API rate-limiting middleware anywhere in the codebase. Access control uses an ACL interceptor (`server/router/api/v1/acl_config.go`), not rate limiting.

**r03** — False premise. There is no nightly database-cleanup cron job. While a scheduler library exists at `internal/scheduler/`, it is not used by any server startup code. No cleanup job is registered anywhere.

**r04** — False premise. There is no message broker (neither NATS nor RabbitMQ). Webhook delivery uses a simple in-process Go buffered channel (`asyncPostQueue = make(chan *WebhookRequestPayload, 128)`) with 4 goroutine workers, all defined in `internal/webhook/webhook.go`.

**r05** — False premise. There is no GraphQL schema. The public API is defined using gRPC with Protocol Buffers (proto files in `proto/api/v1/`), exposed via gRPC-Gateway (REST/JSON transcoding) and Connect protocol. Gateway registration is in `server/router/api/v1/v1.go`.
